services.name: Sailing Club
services.desc: Membership at Harbor Yacht Clubs entitles you to discounted rates on all of our sailboat rentals in San Diego as well as our US SAILING classes. Two membership program options are currently offered that you may choose from when you enroll in the club. A Sailing Club membership is valuable to sailors of all levels of experience, and our programs are designed for both local and out of town sailors. Your membership comes at a low cost so that you can gain all of the benefits of sailing without the hassle and expense of boat ownership.
